title: Studies
unavailable.title: Studies are not available here
about.title: About studies
about.body: A study compares versions of one release: the fixed lesson path, the lessons with the chat companion, and full AI supervision. Learners join only by agreeing in their own app; each is assigned a version by a seeded, balanced draw that never changes. Exports are pseudonymous and every download is recorded.

cellSize.placementOn: Arms smaller than {min, number} are left out of exports. Placement is on for this course, the same in every arm.
cellSize.placementOff: Arms smaller than {min, number} are left out of exports. Placement is off for this course, the same in every arm.

warnings.title: Check before relying on the results
recruiting: “{title}” is recruiting. Learners on this release now see the consent prompt.
allocation.ok: All {checked, number} assignment(s) match the seeded draw ({allocated, number} made in total).
allocation.mismatch: {mismatches, number} of {checked, number} assignment(s) do not match the seeded draw.

confirmClose.title: Close this study?
confirmClose.body: Recruiting ends and every learner returns to the course as everyone else has it. Collected data stays exportable. A closed study cannot reopen.
form.releaseHint: Learners pinned to this release can join.
form.title: Title
form.purposeHint: Plain language, 20 to 2000 characters. Learners read this before deciding.
form.setsHelp: Choose the existing assessment items that form each set. Delayed checks are the course's held-out retention items; the retention schedule offers them after an objective is demonstrated.
form.noItems: This release has no assessment items.
form.cellSizeHint: Arms with fewer consenting learners than this are left out of exports (3 to 100).
usability.on: Usability timing: on. {count, plural, one {# timed step} other {# timed steps}} received so far.
form.usability: Also time how participants find their way in the app
form.usabilityHint: The learner app records how long each person takes to find the next step, how many other buttons they try first, and whether they get back to the same place after opening help. Only times and counts, never what they type or which lesson they are in. Participants are told this before they join, and it cannot be changed once recruiting starts.
file.label: Fill in from a file (optional)
file.hint: A study definition saved as JSON, such as the study.json a course ships: title, purpose, versions, check questions and minimum group size. It only fills in this form. Nothing is saved until you choose Save, and you can change anything first.
file.loaded: Filled in from {name}: {arms} versions and {items} check questions. Review the form, then save.
file.notJson: That file is not readable JSON. Choose the study definition file (for example study.json) and try again.
file.notDefinition: That file is not a study definition: "{field}" is missing or not valid. Check the file against the course's study.json.
file.armBehaviourTwice: The file has two versions of the kind "{arm}". This form takes one of each kind; remove one from the file.
file.unknownItems: These check questions are not in the chosen release: {items}. Pick the release the definition was written for.
file.tooLarge: That file is too large for a study definition (over 200 KB). Choose the study definition file.
